notes.title: version 1.0.4
notes.content: Improved Camera System and Enhanced Car Sounds in Latest Update: We're excited to announce a significant enhancement to our camera system based on your valuable feedback! Now, in the video settings menu, you can adjust the camera smoothing to your preference. The default setting is set to 'Medium Smooth', offering a balanced experience. For those who prefer the pre-patch camera feel, select the 'Very Low Smooth' option. Plus, we've tweaked some car sounds for a more pleasant auditory experience. Thanks for helping us make the game even better!
